books.title: Everything Is Tuberculosis
books.author: John Green
discussion_prompts: John Green argues that tuberculosis isn't just a medical problem, but a social and political one, too. How much of a disease's impact comes down to the conditions people live in?
Do you think the way society responds to TB would be different if it mainly affected wealthy countries? Why?
Did the book change how you think about the relationship between science and morality? Is discovering a treatment enough if people can't access it?
How do stigma and the tendency to blame people for their illnesses make diseases like TB harder to address? Why is it sometimes easier to blame individuals than to look at the bigger picture?

books.title: The Secret History
books.author: Donna Tartt
books.summary: A group of eccentric classics students at an elite Vermont college are drawn into a murder, and the novel traces how they got there and what it costs them afterward.
discussion_prompts: What did you think of the epilogue?
Any ideas what Henry said to Camilia?
What did you think of all of the romantic connections? Was the author trying to tell us something?
What did you think of Bunny? Did you feel bad for him, dislike him, or experience both? How does the way the group views him affect how we see his murder?

books.title: Final Girls
books.author: Riley Sager
books.summary: Years after surviving a massacre, Quincy Carpenter is pulled back into her past when another famous 'final girl' dies and a third shows up at her door with secrets of her own.

books.title: Babel
books.author: R. F. Kuang
books.summary: At Oxford's Royal Institute of Translation, a young scholar discovers how the magic of language props up the British Empire, and must decide whether to serve it or resist.

books.title: A Game of Thorns
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.summary: An epic tale of political intrigue, shifting alliances, and looming supernatural threats, where noble families battle for control of the Iron Throne in a brutal and unpredictable fantasy world.

books.title: The Metamorphosis
books.author: Franz Kafka
books.summary: A haunting exploration of alienation and identity, this novella follows Gregor Samsa after he mysteriously transforms into an insect, revealing the fragility of family, duty, and human connection.

books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.author: L. M. Montgomery
books.summary: A heartwarming coming-of-age story about imaginative and spirited Anne Shirley, whose arrival at Green Gables transforms the lives of those around her in the charming community of Avonlea.
